scope: WP-09 — Three-section navigation and profile screens (T-901 … T-908)
result_scope: T-901 … T-908. The 360/390/430 layout is verified as a layout contract (single-column, wrapping, no fixed width over 360 px, 44 px hit targets, a narrow-phone breakpoint, forced-colors and reduced-motion blocks). A real pixel capture at the three widths needs a browser and is recorded as NOT_RUN in `limitations` rather than claimed here.

what_was_built: `sections`: exactly three primary sections in product order — Discover (/discover), Activity (/activity), My Profile (/me)
`secondaryDestinations`: the five concert screens (world, feed, meet, gifts, wall) in their old order, behind one labelled disclosure
`legacyRedirects`: a closed table of the paths whose meaning changed (/meet/people → /discover/people, /meet/intro/edit → /discover/intro, /people/* → /discover/people/*)
`sectionForPath` / `isPrimaryPath`: whole-segment matching, so /notifications activates Activity and /notifications-settings does not
`panelRoutes` gains the section routes; the old tab paths stay registered so every old URL still resolves
T-901.command: corepack pnpm@11.7.0 exec vitest run src/app/__tests__/navigation.test.tsx

what_was_built: One presentational component with an owner and a visitor variant: introduction, favorites, emo character, photos/artwork, room entry
The owner variant adds the owner-only settings links; the visitor variant adds follow and report and no owner-only control
No room preview inline: one RoomEntry link, no scene, thumbnail, poster or layout data
No age: the view model has no age field, so the page cannot render one
The visitor page shows the introduction, the shared interests, the photos/artwork, the room entry and a follow action
`decodeVisitorProfile` is a closed schema: a payload carrying an `age` field is refused, not narrowed
`admitGenderBucket` accepts only female/male/unknown; anything else renders nothing
`sharedInterestLine` returns null for an empty or blank list, so the section is omitted entirely

Every section screen registered: /discover, /discover/people, /discover/people/:profileId, /discover/people/:profileId/room, /discover/intro, /discover/intro/:introId, /activity, /notifications/:notificationId, /me/identity, /me/posts/new, /me/room
Each section screen is a `lazy` import; the build emits one chunk per screen (DiscoverPanel, ActivityPanel, MyProfilePanel, PhotoComposerPanel, IdentitySettingsPanel, IntroSlot)
`LegacyRedirect` is registered before the panel routes and renders a `replace` navigation that carries the query string
The not-found state renders no profile or post data: no field, no id, no user-entered segment

what_was_built: The identity settings screen composes WP-04b's IdentityStatus and states the purpose and the non-requirement in one sentence each
Reachable from My Profile via the owner profile page's 'Identity verification' link; not offered to a visitor
Disconnect goes through the confirmation dialog; reconnecting is the reverse action
This is the only screen that shows the owner's derived age
Every interactive control on every new screen has an accessible name (explicit label, aria-label, labelledby, implicit label or title)
No keyboard trap: no aria-modal, no inert body, every control focusable and focus can leave the shell
aria-pressed on the follow toggle; aria-current on the section bar
Live regions for asynchronous results
360/390/430 layout contract: single-column pages, wrapping long words, no fixed width over 360 px, 44 px hit targets, a max-width 380 px breakpoint, forced-colors and reduced-motion blocks

limitations: UI-360-390-430 pixel captures are NOT_RUN. The layout contract is verified in the stylesheets (single column, wrapping, no fixed width over 360 px, 44 px hit targets, a max-width 380 px breakpoint, forced-colors and reduced-motion blocks), but a real capture at 360/390/430 needs a browser run that this environment does not provide.

The mutuals-intro screens are a reserved slot. WP-05 owns them; this package registers `/discover/intro` and `/discover/intro/:introId` and renders an explicit placeholder that says the screens are not part of this build yet. It does not depend on `features/intros`.

The visitor profile screen renders the presentational `PublicProfilePage` from a view model. The shell wiring that fills that model from a server read is the integration step; the route, the decoder and the page are in place.

The concert `PublicProfile` (the social owner's profile, with sharing and blocking) is still what `/discover/people/:profileId` mounts, because the concert profile owns the sharing and block flows the product still needs. The WP-09 visitor page is the product-shaped presentation and is asserted separately; switching the route to it is the integration step once the profile service read is wired.
`/me` is now the My Profile section home (the owner profile page). The concert MeHub it used to render moved to `/me/profile`, which the section links to.
